河岸的一天(A Day at the river bank): 围绕自然环境的A1短文:介绍米娅的日常、喜好与河岸。
My friend Sam is very kind. Mia and Sam are in the same class. We often go to the bookstore together. What's more, work hard and you will prove yourself one day.
Mia wants to visit London. We talk about history a lot. The green hill is big and clean. In fact, the morning air is fresh.
After school, we play together. I am happy every day. Mia's favorite season is autumn.
